CAF.note: Draft law mentions administrative data as a requirement only; no work or publication stated.
Statistics law is not a digital law or policy.

facts.fact: ICASEES states the statistics law currently in force is Loi n°01.008 of 16 July 2001.

ICASEES says the 58-article, 6-chapter draft statistics law was validated internally in March 2026 and at a national validation workshop on 23 April 2026, then reviewed on 6 May 2026 before transmission for adoption.
